question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

Liable to catch fire easily
solution:
The correct answer is "**Inflammable**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the word "inflammable" can replace the given phrase.
 
• **"Inflammable" means something that is easily capable of catching fire.**(ज्वलनशील)
 
 
• Example: It burst into flames after its highly inflammable gas ignited.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Agnostic", means someone who is unsure or skeptical about the existence of a higher power. (अनीश्वरवादी)
 
• Option 3, "Venial", means a minor or forgivable offense.(क्षम्य)
 
• Option 4, "Incombustible", means incapable of catching fire. (आग पकड़ने में असमर्थ)
